slipway.assemble.too_large: The structure is wider than %s blocks. Is it touching the ground?
slipway.assemble.unloaded: The structure reaches into unloaded chunks

slipway.disassemble.blocked: Cannot disassemble: %2$s is in the way at %1$s

slipway.helm.hover_on: Hover on: the vessel holds its position
slipway.helm.hover_off: Hover off: gravity applies, and water carries what the hull displaces
slipway.helm.level_on: Level on: the vessel rights itself
slipway.helm.level_off: Level off: the vessel holds its attitude
slipway.helm.loose_on: Loose on: the vessel is a free body, helm controls are off
slipway.helm.loose_off: Loose off: hover, level and helm controls apply again
